clips.title: The story
paras: The Scarlet Watch Post is an isolated watchtower stationed in the rocky hills of northeastern Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Scarlet Monastery. Maintained by a vigilant garrison of Crusaders, its sole purpose is to safeguard the monastery's vulnerable northern flank against flanking assaults.

Perched in the rugged heights behind the Scarlet Monastery, the Scarlet Watch Post serves as a critical early-warning bastion for the zealots below. While the southern road up to the monastery gate receives heavy traffic and fortifications, the rugged cliffs along Tirisfal's northern coastline provide a tempting back route for infiltrators. To eliminate this blind spot, the Scarlet Crusade maintains this fortified stone tower—one of several Crusader outposts scattered across Tirisfal Glades. Under the stern command of Captain Melrache, a mixed force of Neophytes, Vanguards, and devout Friars keeps ceaseless vigil over the cliffs, ensuring neither the Scourge nor the Forsaken can surprise the order from behind.
